scope: capture a live dedrun gamestate and attempt to decrypt it with the netchan key

decrypt_attempt.diagnosis: the key guess is wrong; the first 8 bytes decode to noise and the 07/04 patterns are ciphertext artifacts, not a valid svc_EOF/svc_gamestate header

why_the_key_could_be_wrong: the encoder may use sv_serverid rather than client->serverId in the low byte
messageAck in the key may be the value at encode time, not the value we sampled afterwards
the command stream may not be empty: reliableCommands[reliableAck&127] could contain a command that advances the rolling key
the cipher may start at a different offset (the first 4 bytes we strip as seq may already be part of the ciphered region)
next: brute force the key byte over 0..255 and score each candidate by whether the plaintext begins with 07 00 00 00 00 01 00 00 00 (svc_EOF then svc_gamestate as a long)
if no single-byte key works, try the full command-driven rolling key with candidate command strings
keep the capture (runs/dec-in.jsonl) so the analysis can be redone offline without another session
